bio: Andrew Schneider is an Obie Award–winning and Drama Desk–nominated performer, writer, director, and interactive-electronics artist creating original works for theater, dance, sound, video, installation, and public art. At Radcliffe, he will write a play centered around the simulation hypothesis and AI’s role in hastening the singularity.
